## COCCIDIOIDOMYCES
Pulmonary and Infectious Diseases consultations are essential for diagnosis and
treatment.
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Duration of therapy is dependent upon location and severity of infection,
and response to therapy. Consult Infectious Diseases for more information.
## Mild to moderate disease
Observation alone is indicated for some cases. Consult Infectious Diseases for
more information. If antifungal treatment is indicated:
Preferred treatment
## Inpatient

Itraconazole 200 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]
Alternative
Fluconazole 400 mg PO q24h ($) [R,DI]
## Severe disease (diffuse pneumonia, rapid progression or central nervous system
 infection)
Preferred treatment
Alternative
Fluconazole 400-800 mg IV q24h ($) [R,DI]
## Outpatient

Itraconazole 200 mg PO BID ($) [DI]
Non-VA order for above
Alternative
Fluconazole 400 mg PO QDay ($) [R,DI]
Non-VA order for above
## Severe disease (diffuse pneumonia, rapid progression or central nervous system
## infection)
Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.
